research_scope: Independent Wave2 source-free contextual match to existing finite square-matrix trace definition. No citation certification, new source, breadth extension or original-formulation edit.

resolutions.review_rationale: The field-trace source requires the trace of the K-linear multiplication endomorphism m_alpha:L→L for finite field extension L/K. Choosing a K-basis of L gives a finite square matrix of m_alpha; its trace is exactly the sum of diagonal entries in the corpus's existing square-matrix trace definition and is basis-independent. The multiplication operator, extension L/K and field-trace terminology remain parent-specific; the existing matrix-trace meaning supplies the required common arithmetic operation.
